lede: We create premier social events for young adults to build meaningful community in DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

pillars.heading: Build community
pillars.text: DC Social Collective brings together hundreds of young adults each month, consistently filling venues and making space for real connection. Whether you are new to town or just looking for your crew, this is the easiest way to meet people your age in the region.

pillars.heading: Premier events
pillars.text: Our events sell out. From rooftop soirees to barn dances, we bring hundreds of people together across the DMV, working with the best local venues, musicians, and small businesses to make nights that are memorable, stylish, and well run.

pillars.heading: Faith through friendship
pillars.text: DSC is rooted in a Catholic vision and open to everyone. We think authentic community changes lives, and that joyful, high-energy gatherings are a good way to meet it.

letter.body:
When I graduated from George Mason University in 2019, I struggled for nearly a year in isolation without solid friendships or community.

Through local parish involvement and an independent Catholic men's group I started with two buddies of mine, I began to build the friendships I had been longing for.

In 2021 I launched DC Social Collective as a COVID effort to help restore and rebuild the young adult community that was lost to the pandemic. Since then it has helped thousands of young adults across DC, Maryland, and Virginia find and build real friendships of their own.
letter.closing: If you know someone who is struggling the way I did after college, please send them our way.
letter.name: Christopher Byrne

sideCaption: A few hundred people in one room on an ordinary Friday. The National Catholic Register wrote about how DSC started and what it has become in "Faith Through Friendship."
